summary: A chance-gated execute segment (dmg(..., {execute:true, chance})) that fails its roll records no castTracking.lastTarget, so a following dmg("lastTarget") has no target. Native LethalDamageConditional@LastEnemy/SecondLastEnemy followed by (True)Damage on the same Target (weapon:1435, troop:6470) cannot be written in native order (R001) without either losing the damage (lastTarget) or re-targeting the next enemy after a slay (enemyLast). Proposal: record the resolved victim in castTracking before the chance roll (or add a per-cast pinned target for positional modes).
repro: weapon:1435 with [execute enemyLast, trueDmg lastTarget]: castSpell({key:"weapon:1435",seed:1}) -> order []; with [execute enemyLast, trueDmg enemyLast] and 16 Doomskulls -> dmg E13 803, defeat E13, dmg E12 13.

note: prototypes.ts runSegment: failed chance roll of a damage execute segment still resolves+tracks its targets; 8664 (weapon:1435) native order execute enemyLast -> trueDmg lastTarget, accepted L7; troop:6470 already accepted (damage-before-lethal is native order), unchanged; golden diff 0
